state.paragraph: The Board determined that the G&W offer represented the superior proposal. At the request of the Board, representatives of BMO reviewed BMO's financial analyses supporting its opinion to the Board as to the fairness, from a financial point of view, to the holders of our common stock of the consideration to be received by those holders (other than the Eder Trusts) in the merger pursuant to the merger agreement as of August 12, 2016. At the request of the Board, BMO confirmed that it did not have any existing or contemplated material relationships with G&W in connection with the provision of any financial advisory or financing services to G&W. BMO then rendered an oral opinion to the Board, subsequently confirmed by delivery of a written opinion, dated August 12, 2016 to the effect that, as of that date, and based upon and subject to the various assumptions made, procedures followed, matters considered and qualifications and limitations on the scope of review undertaken by BMO as set forth in its written opinion, the merger consideration to be received by the holders of our common stock in the merger pursuant to the merger agreement was fair, from a financial point of view, to those holders (other than the Eder Trusts). Following a discussion of the terms of the merger agreement and related matters, the Board (other than Director Smith, who recused himself from the August 12, 2016 meeting) (i) determined that the merger agreement, the plan of merger and the merger and other transactions contemplated by the merger agreement are fair to, advisable and in the best interests of the Company and its shareholders, (ii) approved and declared advisable the merger agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including the merger and the plan of merger, (iii) directed that the merger agreement be submitted to the Company's shareholders for approval and (iv) resolved to recommend that the Company's shareholders approve the merger agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including the merger and the plan of merger.

ledger_rows.Note: Carried from #24; reaffirmed by returned draft: B's counsel sent a revised merger agreement as the Company moved to complete the agreement with B (#44). On-site diligence continued to 08/11.
Target told G&W it intended to sign with another bidder. G&W asked to continue diligence (on-site 08/10-11) toward a better offer; granted. On 08/11 G&W signalled a revised LOI.
G&W's legal counsel; first seen acting 08/10/2016.
All-cash revised LOI; CVR dropped; mark-ups of merger and voting agreements; offer expiring 6 p.m. next day. Physical diligence done 08/11; agreement signed that day, without financing condition.
At its 10:30 a.m. meeting, the Committee had BMO tell B that a higher revised LOI had arrived. In the afternoon, the Board had BMO ask B to raise its price.
Declined to raise its $24.00 offer (#46). Board found G&W's $25.00 superior; the drafts otherwise differed on the termination fee (lower for G&W) and on the STB approval route.
$25.00 cash per common share (each preferred share converts into 100 common). Termination fee 3% ($3.785M). Eder Trusts signed voting agreement. Board approved 08/12 (Smith recused).

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
